mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY request_id) AS reverse_rownum, r.lecture_id, r.request_id, r.request_name, r.birthday, r.gender, r.phone_number, r.email, r.zip_code, r.address1, r.address2, r.request_status, r.request_type, r.complete_yn, r.cancel_yn, r.add_date, r.add_ip, r.add_id, r.cancel_date, r.cancel_ip, r.cancel_id, i.lecture_title, i.course_id FROM LECTURE_REQUEST as r INNER JOIN LECTURE_INFO as i ON r.lecture_id = i.lecture_id WHERE r.request_id = #{request_id}
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'REQUEST_' || (TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(REPLACE(request_id, 'REQUEST_', '')), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') || LPAD(0, 4, '0'))) + 1) FROM LECTURE_REQUEST WHERE request_id LIKE '%' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') || '%'
INSERT INTO LECTURE_REQUEST ( lecture_id,request_id,request_name,birthday,gender,phone_number,email,zip_code,address1,address2, request_status,request_type,complete_yn,cancel_yn,add_date,add_ip,add_id,homepage_id ) VALUES ( #{lecture_id},#{request_id},#{request_name},#{birthday},#{gender},#{phone_number},#{email},#{zip_code}, #{address1},#{address2},#{request_status},#{request_type},#{complete_yn}, #{cancel_yn},SYSDATE,#{add_ip},#{add_id},#{homepage_id} )
mapper.update: UPDATE LECTURE_REQUEST SET lecture_id = #{lecture_id}, request_name = #{request_name}, birthday = #{birthday}, gender = #{gender}, phone_number = #{phone_number}, email = #{email}, zip_code = #{zip_code}, address1 = #{address1}, address2 = #{address2}, request_status = #{request_status}, request_type = #{request_type}, complete_yn = #{complete_yn}, cancel_yn = #{complete_yn}, cancel_id = #{cancel_id}, cancel_ip = #{cancel_ip}, cancel_date = #{cancel_date} WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND request_id = #{request_id}
UPDATE LECTURE_REQUEST SET cancel_yn = #{cancel_yn}, cancel_date = SYSDATE, cancel_id = #{cancel_id}, cancel_ip = #{cancel_ip} WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND request_id = #{request_id}
